title: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its At Market Issuance Sales Agreement, which adds Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. and removes Wedbush Securities Inc. from the group of distribution agents. The company also filed a prospectus supplement pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5). This is a routine corporate securities filing for a small REIT; it contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Strawberry Fields REIT (ticker: STRW, listed on NYSE American) entered into Amendment No. 2 to its At Market Issuance Sales Agreement on April 14, 2026.
The amendment adds Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. as an agent and removes Wedbush Securities Inc. from the distribution group.
B. Riley Securities, Inc. and A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners remain as agents.
The company filed Prospectus Supplement No. 2 pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5) in connection with the at-the-market equity offering program.
Risk factors were updated via Exhibit 99.1 but specific content is not disclosed in this filing.
The registration statement is Form S-3 (File No. 333-280766).
